## Exercise 1 · Calculations

## Exercise 1
Calculate the mean of the numbers 120, 135, 128 and 142.
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mean(c(120, 135, 128, 142))
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 131.25
```

## Exercise 2
Import `patients.csv` into an object called `patients`. How many rows and columns does it have?
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}

```


## Exercise 3 · First look

::: {.callout-note .exercise}
## Exercise 3
What is the average age of the patients? How many received the **New** treatment?
:::

::: {.content-visible when-profile="instructor"}
::: {.solution}

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
mean(patients$age)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] 51.54
```


:::

```{.r .cell-code}

```

```

     New Standard
```
